## Big idea

Make intent obvious:

```java
@TrackTime
public void importData() { ... }
```

## Steps

1. Declare `@TrackTime` (method annotation, runtime retention).
2. Write aspect with `@Around("@annotation(TrackTime)")`.
3. Put annotation on service methods.

## Practice

Build `@TrackTime` and print duration. Optional: `@RequireRole` style guard that throws if a header is missing (learning only — real security later).
